from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/salam-ae-ghareeb.md')
before = p.read_bytes()
header, roman, body = before.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[0], *before.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].split('\\n---\\n', 1)
changes = {
'ae adam': 'ae Aadam',
'ae nuh o ibrahim o musa o isa': 'ae Nuh o Ibraahim o Musa o Isa',
'ae mohamed o ali o zahra': 'ae Muhammad o Ali o Zahra',
'gharib-e-zahra': 'gharib-e-Zahra',
'din e khuda': 'din-e-Khuda',
'kaaba': 'Kaaba',
'waaris e adam hai waaris e isa': 'waaris-e-Aadam hai waaris-e-Isa',
'khud mohamed': 'khud Muhammad',
'Ter rauze': 'Tere rauze',
'qaid nahi hai': 'qaid nahiṅ hai',
'aalam e insaniyat ka wirsa': 'aalam-e-insaaniyat ka waaris',
'chor kar': 'chhor kar',
'ko pani bana': 'ko paani pila',
'nibhaya nana': 'nibhaaya naana',
'Khuda ki raah meiṅ tu ne luta': 'Khuda ki raah meiṅ tu ne luta',
'Jawan bete': 'Jawaan bete',
'mere shahid': 'mere shahid',
'qatil al abaraat': 'qatil al-abaraat',
'Ba waqt e asr': 'Ba waqt-e-asr',
'na ye dikhaye': 'na ye dikhaaye',
'Dhala jo asr ka suraj': 'Dhala jo asr ka suraj',
'laasha e besar': 'laasha-e-besar',
'aayi ek bacchi': 'aayi ik bachchi',
'kaha ye rote huwe': 'kaha ye rote hue',
'Usi nasheb': 'Isi nashib',
'rahe hai Husain': 'rahe haiṅ Husain',
'Sina ki': 'Sinaaṅ ki',
'quraṅ': 'Quraaṅ',
'hai takallum khuda': 'hai Takallum Khuda',
'Khuda ki saari khudayi': 'Khuda ki saari khudaayi',
'Assalam alaika ya abaab dillah': 'Assalamu alaika ya Aba Abdillah',
}
for old, new in changes.items():
    assert old in roman, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
roman = roman.replace('gharib-e-Zahra..\\n', 'gharib-e-Zahra...\\n')
import re
assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for c in roman)
roman_lines = roman.splitlines()
source_lines = body.strip().splitlines()
assert len(roman_lines) == len(source_lines) and roman_lines[0].strip() == '1' and source_lines[0] == '۱'
after = (header + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman + '\\n---\\n' + body).encode()
assert after.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == before.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
p.write_bytes(after)
print(f'Checked alignment of {len(source_lines)-1} verse pairs; Urdu body and other metadata preserved.')
